    • getAssetType

      public String getAssetType()
      Returns the asset of this output.

      Zephyr: null for the outputs that getOutputs() returns in the full wallet (ZephyrWalletFull): the core keeps an output's asset but does not serialize it. Through ZephyrWalletRpc it is null as well for now (the RPC client does not read the asset yet). The wallet's getOutputAssetType(output) takes the asset from the output's transaction. The outputs of the listener callbacks carry the asset, except for an output seen in the pool (""). See the user guide, docs/guide/08-known-limitations.md, section "getOutputs() reports no asset".

      Overrides:
      getAssetType in class ZephyrOutput
      Returns:
      the asset name (see ZephyrAssets), null if not known
